北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友，气温低体感冷，外出记得多穿衣保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's cold, so remember to dress warmly when going out!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感微凉。记得添衣，注意防风哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and feels cool. Remember to add layers and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感微凉。出行别忘添衣，小心着凉。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast and feels cool. Don't forget to layer up and stay warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温舒适。记得多喝水，防晒哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and pleasant. Stay hydrated and remember sun protection!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光灿烂，气温宜人。保持心情好，多补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and lovely. Stay cheerful and hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感较凉。别忘加件外套，小心感冒！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and cool. Don't forget a jacket and watch out for colds!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，气温偏低。出门穿暖点，别冻着了！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and cool. Dress warmly when going out to avoid catching a chill!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，温度适中。带件薄外套，保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast with mild temps. Bring a light jacket and stay cheerful.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感偏凉。记得添衣，小心风寒哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and feels cool. Remember to add layers and watch out for chills!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感较冷。多穿厚衣物，注意防寒！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and feels cold. Wear thick clothes and stay warm!
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，湿度大。外出带伞，小心湿冷感冒。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast with high humidity. Take an umbrella and watch out for damp cold!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨天晴，户外极寒。务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold outdoors. Dress fully and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴，气温很低。多穿厚衣，小心保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and very cold. Wear thick clothes and stay warm!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，气温舒适。享受美好时光，保持心情！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant. Enjoy the beautiful weather and stay cheerful!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，风力较大。出门注意防风，小心着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with strong winds. Watch out for the wind and stay warm.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感偏冷。记得添衣防风，注意保暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels cold. Remember to layer up, prevent wind chill, and stay warm!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感寒冷。外出记得多穿衣，别冻着。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels very cold. Remember to bundle up when going out.
